text: Design Studies (Design Research) is a multidisciplinary and comprehensive major that goes beyond the traditional "skill-based practice" aspect of design, focusing on the essence, context, influence, and future possibilities of design. This major centers on critical thinking and integrates perspectives from various disciplines such as sociology, psychology, cultural studies, and philosophy of technology, to explore the complex relationships between design and society, culture, technology, and economy. The aim is to understand "why design exists", "how design shapes the world", and "how to solve systemic problems through design".
